title: Kissed Smoky Australian Lamb Skewers
description: Smoky and velvety Australian lamb skewers featuring parmigiano-reggiano, perfect for a macrobiotic-friendly dinner
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Grill the skewers for 10 minutes, turning occasionally
In a small bowl, mix together grated parmigiano-reggiano and lemon juice
Brush the parmigiano-reggiano mixture onto the lamb skewers during the last 2 minutes of grilling
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parmigiano-reggiano if desired
